IFC Viewer SDK License Terms (v2026-11)

Version: v2026-11 Back to latest
Read in particular: Section 3 (Permitted use), Section 4 (Uses that require an Enterprise agreement) and Section 3 item 5 (Flinker branding). Plan details and request limits are shown on the pricing page.

1. Scope

These terms govern the use of the Flinker IFC Viewer SDK (“SDK”) under the Community and Pro plans. Use under the Enterprise plan is governed by a separate written agreement. The Flinker GmbH Terms & Conditions apply in addition. Where they conflict, these terms prevail for the SDK.
